title: Rav Shmuel bar Rav Ketina
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Berakhot 46a in Hyman’s print, with the matching account at [47a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.47a.7-8), Rabbah bar bar Chana was arranging his son’s wedding at the house of Rav Shmuel bar Rav Ketina. Rami bar Chama said to him…

In [Shabbat 29a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.29a.7), Shmuel bar Rav Ketina speaks to Rav Yosef in the reading Hyman cites from Dikdukei Soferim (supplied מב״י א״פ). Hyman adds that this reading was known to the author of Yuchasin.[^4]

notes.text: The additional textual-evidence sigla מב״י א״פ are unresolved. The heading and Shabbat report have Rav Ketina, while the Berakhot citation abbreviates the father’s title.

No new DikdukeiSoferim witness was supplied for מב״י א״פ; manuscript-siglum expansions remain unverified and are not inserted. Supplied Berakhot בר׳ abbreviates the father’s title, beside full RavKetina elsewhere in this same notice. Shabbat’s Shmuel remains untitled. The marriage-arrangement idiom is retained rather than reverting to employment. Rami’s incomplete speech remains an allusion, and Hyman’s Yuchasin reading-history assertion remains attributed rather than newly proved.

Hyman’s Berakhot citation is printed as 46a. The consulted passage at 47a names Rav Shmuel bar Rav Ketina, reports preparations for a wedding at his house, and has Rami bar Chama question Rav Chisda’s view. The consulted Shabbat 29a names Rav Shmuel bar bar Chana. The note marked ה in Dikdukei Soferim reports the Ketina reading in manuscript א״פ and says the author of Yuchasin knew it. The apparatus prints בכ״י א״פ beside the supplied transcription מב״י א״פ. The siglum א״פ remains unexplained here, and the Yuchasin edition itself has not been checked.

The corresponding [Seder HaDorot entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3371&lang=en) gives Berakhot 47a for the wedding. The [Rif of Berakhot](https://www.sefaria.org/Rif_Berakhot.34b.2) names Rabbah bar Rav Huna and Rav Daniel bar Rav Ketina in its version of the passage. The linked Shabbat text has Rav Shmuel bar bar Chana speaking to Rav Yosef.
